normalization_plan.reason: sender is a parameter local to _transferFrom and should be folded into the transfer function node.
recipient is a parameter local to _transferFrom and should be folded into the transfer function node.
amount is a parameter local to _transferFrom and should be folded into the transfer function node.
amountToSwap is a local used only inside swapBack.
amountBNB is a local that feeds the external marketing ETH transfer.
amountToLiquify is a local that feeds the addLiquidityETH external call.
amountPercentage is a parameter that only controls buyBack.
adr is a parameter that directly determines the raw ETH transfer destination.
tokenAddress is a parameter that directly selects the external token transfer target.
tokens is a parameter used only for the external token transfer amount.
_wallets is a parameter iterated only inside protectWallet.
walletLimit is a local copy of _maxWalletSize inside checkWalletLimit.
feeAmount is a local fee value computed inside takeFee.
_team is a parameter that only writes the teamMember privilege mapping.
_enabled is a parameter that only toggles team membership.
amountETH is a local used only for the external router swap in buyBack.
path is a local array built only for the external router swap.
balanceBefore is a local snapshot used only around the external router swap accounting.
